title: Wish Blossom
team: Myeongseong Kim, Kyeongho Park, Sohyun Park, Wonyoung Lee, Seunghyeon Han, Woohun Lee
summary: an interactive installation that transforms fleeting cherry blossom petals into a poetic expression of visitors’ wishes.
As petals flutter and settle, a symbolic keyword emerges, capturing the essence of each wish in a moment of ephemeral beauty.

paragraph: “Wish Blossom” is an interactive kinetic installation that treats each visitor’s wish as a raw, intangible fiber and spins it into a temporary material phenomenon of air, petals, pressure, and language.
Rather than presenting a wish as a message to be displayed, the work asks how an inner desire can become physically perceptible.
Cherry blossoms, associated with spring, fleeting beauty, and the myth that catching a falling petal can make a wish come true, provide its cultural and material ground. Within this symbolic frame,
Wish Blossom transforms private wishes into fragile atmospheric events that appear, drift, gather, and disappear.
